# Kenney assets (CC0, public domain)

Kept subset actually used by the project (GLB models + licenses + previews).
The full packs also ship FBX/OBJ/DAE/STL and preview renders — deleted here
to keep the repo lean; re-download below if you need them.

- `mini-characters/` — Mini Characters 1.0 (crew avatars, 26 GLBs)
  Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/mini-characters
- `furniture-kit/` — Furniture Kit 2.0 (office furniture, 140 GLBs)
  Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit

License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0) — see `License.txt` in each pack.
No attribution required; credited in the About tab anyway.

Re-download: open each page above, click Download (free, no login),
unzip into this folder.
